channel.title: Bounding Into Comics - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bounding Into Comics (boundingintocomics.com)

item.title: If You Think 'Magic: The Gathering' Is Turning To "Slop," Its Head Designer Thinks You Might Be A Fascist
item.description: Though the term is apt, 'Magic: The Gathering' head designer Mark Rosewater views anyone using the term 'slop' to be flirting with fascists.

item.title: After Declaring Partnership Sales As Revenue, Ubisoft Used Tencent Money To Make Amends For Breaching Loan Agreement
item.description: After incorrectly reporting their financials, Ubisoft repayed a loan early to make amends, using Tencent's investment into Vantage Studios.

item.title: 'Sarah’s Oil' Review: A New Chapter for Zachary Levi?
item.description: Review: 'Sarah’s Oil' is a "faith-based" indie film featuring Zachary Levi that seeks to inspire with its story.

item.title: BIC's New Ask-Me-Anything Series Kicks Off Tomorrow As The Rippaverse's Andrew Rodriguez Stops By To Talk 'Blue-Shift'
item.description: In service of celebrating comic books, BIC is launching a new 'Ask-Me-Anything' series - Our first guest? The Rippaverse's Andrew Rodriguez.

item.title: 'Super Sentai' Ending Officially Confirmed - Make Way For 'PROJECT R.E.D.' And A New 'Space Sheriff Gavan'
item.description: With 'Super Sentai's ending, Toei pass the tokusatsu torch to 'PROJECT R.E.D' and its first entry, 'Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity'

item.title: Terry Gilliam Says 'Fear And Loathing In Las Vegas' To Blame For Rise Of QAnon: "That's How F--king Stupid They Are"
item.description: Rather than Trump or Clinton, Terry Gilliam says 'Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas' and its use of adrenochrome are to blame for QAnon.

item.title: Brendan Fraser Is Pumped For ‘The Mummy 4’, But The Project May Be Negatively Impacting ‘Evil Dead Rise’ Director Lee Cronin’s Version Of The Universal Horror Icon
item.description: Exciting news for fans! Brendan Fraser is set for fourth Mummy, which may undercut chances of success for a Lee Cronin film.

item.title: SEGA Admits New Game Sales "Fell Short Of Expectations" In 2025, Says "Complete Editions" Partly To Blame
item.description: SEGA saw sales slump across 2025 - and the 'Sonic the Hedgehog' parent company says their love of "complete editions" didn't help.

item.title: 'Magic: The Gathering' Admits They Sh*t The Bed With 'Monster Hunter' Secret Lair Drop, Will "Postpone" And "Rework" Capcom Crossover Cards
item.description: For the first time ever, Magic: The Gathering is pulling its upcoming 'Monster Hunter'-themed Secret Lair Drop for lack of quality.

item.title: Report Claims President Donald Trump’s Influence Gives Paramount The Edge In Bids For Warner Bros., While Also Helping Revive The Career of Brett Ratner And The 'Rush Hour' Series!
item.description: Donald Trump's help may hand Warner Bros. to Paramount on a platter, but they have to make 'Rush Hour 4', apparently. It's complicated.
